C1717: Cortech Chuckwagon Insulated Food Tray Delivery Cart
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-c1717-chuckwagon-tray-transport-cart
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/food-service/correctional-food-tray-delivery-carts/chuckwagon/
Spec sheet: C1717
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Chuckwagon Insulated Food Tray Delivery Cart – C1717 / C1717LH
Current H1: Cortech Chuckwagon Tray Transport Cart - C1717
Subtitle: One-Piece Insulated Cart That Holds Up to 150 Rock Trays, with Sliding Doors and an Optional Locking Hasp
Current subtitle: Cortech USA C1717 Chuckwagon Tray Transport Cart
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Chuckwagon Insulated Food Tray Delivery Cart carries meal trays from the kitchen to housing units in prisons, jails, and other correctional facilities. It holds up to 150 Rock Trays, 120 Rock 2.0 Trays, or 108 X-Trays, and it keeps hot food hot and cold food cold on the way.
The cart has a one-piece molded cavity with no seams, no welded walls, and no adhesives, and its walls are filled with high grade insulation. The two insulated sliding doors have no hinges and lift out for cleaning. The C1717LH adds a tamper-resistant locking hasp for the doors.
Material: High impact polyethylene
Construction: One-piece molded cavity with no seams, no welded walls, and no adhesives
Insulation: Walls and doors are filled with high grade insulation to keep hot food hot and cold food cold
Dimensions: 56”L×31”W×64”H
Weight: 250 lbs
Load Capacity: 1,000 lbs
Tray Size: Holds any tray up to 9½”×14½”
Tray Capacity: 150 Rock Trays (96 with lids), 120 Rock 2.0 Trays (84 with lids), or 108 X-Trays (72 with lids); trays sold separately
Doors: Two one-piece insulated sliding doors with no hinges; they lift out for cleaning
Locking Hasp: Optional tamper-resistant locking door latch
Top Surface: Raised top edge safely holds more trays, beverage servers, and wash racks
Handles: Push-pull handles for easy navigation
Casters: Non-marring kingpin-less casters
Bumpers: Built-in wall bumpers
Color: Brown (custom colors available on request)
Warranty: 3-year factory warranty
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
C1717 – Standard: Without locking hasp
C1717LH – With Locking Hasp: Tamper-resistant locking door latch
Installation and Options
Assembly: Hardware bit size is T45
[H2] Applications
The Chuckwagon suits large facilities that deliver hot and cold meals on trays from a central kitchen.
Typical applications include:
Meal delivery from central kitchens to housing units in prisons and jails
Detention centers and juvenile facilities
Other secure facilities that deliver meals on trays
Explore Anchortex's Prison and Detention Kitchen and Food Service Equipment collection for more food trays, delivery carts, and food service supplies.
[H2] About Cortech Food Service
Cortech food service products are made for high-volume meal service in correctional facilities, where trays, carts, and dispensers are used and washed every day. Cortech trays and delivery carts are sized to work together.
Cortech food service includes:
Insulated Food Trays: The Rock, Rock 2.0, Rock with Cor-Flex, and X-Tray, with matching lids
Tray Delivery Carts: The insulated Chuckwagon, Chuckwagon Jr., and Chuckwagon Max, and the non-insulated Tray Master
Beverage Service: The BevMax insulated beverage dispenser
Tray Drying: Aluminum meal tray drying racks
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (59 characters): Cortech Chuckwagon Insulated Tray Cart - C1717 at Anchortex
Meta description (156 characters): Shop the Cortech Chuckwagon. A one-piece insulated food tray delivery cart that holds up to 150 Rock Trays, with sliding doors and an optional locking hasp.
Notes and Questions
Series section: "About Cortech Food Service" is a new section for the food service pages (trays, lids, delivery carts, BevMax, and drying racks). It is the same on each of these pages.
H1: Cortech calls it the Chuckwagon Insulated Food Tray Delivery Cart, so I used that and added the C1717LH.
Weight: your variants are set to 310 lbs. The Cortech spec sheet says 250 lbs, so I used 250 lbs.
Tray capacity: your current page says 102 X-Trays, 108 Rock 2.0 Trays, or 132 Rock Trays. The Cortech spec sheet says 108, 120, and 150, so I used those. The "with lids" numbers come from the Cortech web page.
Warranty: your current page does not list a warranty. The Cortech spec sheet says 3-year factory warranty, so I added it.
I left out "chemically resistant to hazardous fluids and stains" and "Available in plastic or stainless steel base," since the Cortech spec sheet does not say these for this cart. (The stainless steel base is the Chuckwagon Max.)
Collection link: I linked the Prison and Detention Kitchen and Food Service Equipment collection, which this product is already in.
Product images: the page has one image. The Cortech product page has two newer Chuckwagon photos. Would you like me to add them?
